metadata.description: Memex plugins for Claude Code: the Memex MCP server, skills for planning and building Specs, and spec-checkout hooks.

plugins.name: memex-checkout
plugins.description: Memex for Claude Code. Connects Claude to your team's Specs, decisions and tasks in Memex (sign in once with OAuth), adds skills for starting a Spec and building one, and links each file Claude edits to the Spec it is working on. Sends only changed file paths and the Spec; never source code or prompts.
